answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the walnut graph. Re-attestations are stored in anchor and raven lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 981 impostors cost 1058 times the honest price and take 16 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
